method: OpenSim InverseKinematicsTool fitting model markers to MediaPipe pose landmarks.

REJC.reason: No samples met the visibility/presence threshold.

IK_WRIST_R.reason: No samples met the visibility/presence threshold.

right_arm.assumption: Assumed neutral posture, not recovered movement.

neutralization_scope: Coordinate tasks are constant over the full motion. They are not switched on only during missing frames.

root_translation_estimation.pelvis_tx: Held at zero; hip-centered MediaPipe world landmarks do not provide camera-depth translation.

marker_fitting_diagnostics.interpretation: Marker-fitting agreement with transformed pose targets; not a measure of anatomical accuracy.

limitations: MediaPipe world landmarks are estimated and are not camera-calibrated motion capture.
Pose scale and body segment scale factors are estimated from monocular landmarks; segment proportions may be biased by pose estimation errors.
Pelvis camera-depth translation is not observable from hip-centered world landmarks and is held at zero.
Virtual wrist markers are attached to the model hand origins; the model wrist flexion and deviation coordinates are locked.
Markers with no samples above the confidence threshold are omitted; motion of an unobserved limb cannot be recovered reliably.
Single-camera depth ambiguity can affect pelvis and limb rotations.
Marker fit is kinematic only; no inverse dynamics or joint loads are computed.
